comparison.objective: Build a stable 3-2-1 pyramid from six cans; candidate tunes and locks an industrial-axis shock absorber for repeatable guarded stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Can task tests repeated grasping, upright placement, bridge support, and disturbance-free stacking. Candidate tests tool alignment/insertion, retained-adjuster manipulation, bounded tightening, physical control actuation, and iterative dynamic-response correction.
comparison.success_condition: Can task requires specified tier geometry, upright cans, and no can tipped beyond 45°. Candidate requires two compliant ≥0.85 J cycles without bottoming, hard-stop contact, overload, excessive rebound, or post-lock drift. Candidate omits numeric rebound, overload, drift, and locking-torque limits.
comparison.reason: Stable multi-object stacking does not test adjustment, locking, or commissioning from impact response; generic precise placement is insufficient for overlap.
